notes: 2.0 m3/h is the inherited first-phase manual identification candidate from the 2026-08-25 design; it is not a control step limit.
0.5 m3/h max_abs_step_error is only a review candidate inherited from the prior reach-tolerance candidate.
30 s max_sample_gap is supported by the 10 s cadence audit: only 91 of 298874 adjacent intervals exceed 30 s; it remains a review candidate, not a reviewed value.
0.05 pH baseline range is supported as approximately the median 2-minute pH range among stable-flow windows with outlet-SO2 first-last change <=2 mg/Nm3; it remains a review candidate.
600 s is retained as an SO2 early-observation floor; dual-channel closure now requires at least 900 s so the pH P90 peak candidate near 886 s is not truncated.
1800 s remains an observation timeout candidate, not a proven pH memory constant; the current pH memory lower bound is >=1800 s.
min_abs_delta_SO2/pH remain null because the CSV identifies an empirical noise floor but does not choose the engineering safety multiplier above that floor.
Fields left null still require plant review or new evidence.

trial_matrix.rule: No automatic 2->4->6 m3/h escalation. A later step level requires a separate human design review after Phase-1 evidence is complete.

historical_constraints.note: Timing and noise values constrain review but do not fill reviewed identification parameters automatically. Minimum-effect thresholds must be explicitly chosen above the empirical noise floor.

required_preconditions: request explicitly enabled for a supervised identification session
condition snapshot and MFAC context available
actual flow and Qbase valid and sufficiently close
Qbase absolute and relative drift stable
pH inside a reviewed sub-band of the plant operating envelope and pH baseline stable
outlet SO2 retains a reviewed headroom to the plant safe maximum
no recent supply-flow action inside a reviewed quiet interval
inlet SO2 and outlet SO2 baseline sufficiently stable
proposed positive step remains inside plant supply-flow bounds
in_trial_abort_recommendations: condition snapshot or MFAC context changes
pH leaves the plant operating envelope
outlet SO2 reaches the reviewed abort headroom threshold
Qbase drift exceeds the reviewed trial limit
inlet SO2 change exceeds the reviewed trial limit
sample gap exceeds the reviewed maximum
dual_response_success_criteria: SO2 and pH responses belong to the same actual-flow tracking event
safety summary belongs to the same approved trial
actual positive delta-Q matches the approved test step within reviewed tolerance
condition/context/target remain stable and there is no FAST overlap
SO2 response observation meets the reviewed minimum duration
pH response observation meets the reviewed minimum duration
pH remains inside the operating envelope throughout the monitored trial
SO2 and pH response magnitudes exceed separately reviewed minimum-effect thresholds
Qbase and inlet SO2 drift remain inside reviewed evidence limits
notes: No numeric value from unit tests is a site calibration default.
Review candidates are inherited engineering or data-derived candidates, not reviewed plant parameters.
The +2.0 m3/h identification stimulus is not the runtime planner max_step_up and is never a 10-second recurrent increment.
A completed test must pass actual-flow tracking, independent SO2/pH response attribution and the trial evidence gate before it can inform phi.
Production remains LEARN=0, Residual=0, DCS write=off.
